marketing-workspace.brief: A fresh workspace with a readable conversation, one attached safe sample document, and a downloadable result. Capture the full app at a legible desktop size; avoid empty onboarding, account names, private paths, and invented output.
marketing-workspace.acceptance: Recognition: the reviewer can identify chat, attachment, and result controls; verify on the captured commit.

marketing-first-task.brief: From a connected model, attach a public sample document, ask one bounded question, and open the real generated result. Keep the model wait visible or label any time compression. Supply poster, transcript, captions for narration, and a text procedure.
marketing-first-task.acceptance: A new viewer can follow the action and recognize the result; test controls and playback on desktop and mobile.

marketing-memory.brief: Capture a safe saved preference and the injection view for a turn that received it. Use actual state, redact personal data, and retain source capture plus annotation project.
marketing-memory.acceptance: The source and injected context can be matched; caption must not promise every saved item reaches every turn.

marketing-fleet.brief: Show two disposable local agents and one completed real handoff. Capture the fleet view with no production names, endpoints, tokens, or private task content.
marketing-fleet.acceptance: Roles and returned result are readable; verify the handoff in the captured environment.
